pictures.author: Moonik
pictures.observed: Faceted projecting blue upper bay, pale pointed upper window screens, lower dark windows/gold grilles, pale marble lower wall and balcony on brackets. Broad lead canopy with warm coffered soffit/red edge, slim pale curved braces, pointed arcade and descending garden stair. Fountain, mosque and wider terrace remain independent.

pictures.author: Moonik
pictures.observed: Revan portico is on the right of the pool: high open pointed bays, grey circular shafts/pale capitals/gold collars, iron ties and low pale railing; adjacent Mosque of Sofa and pool fountain are separate structures.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Yerevan Kiosk within its distinct four-corner canopy: faceted blue upper room with three projecting window bays, pale lower marble panels/gold grilles, long open pointed portico and pale shafts/capitals, broad lead hip/colored soffit, shallow domed chamber and a descending garden stair/balcony. Independent Sacred Relics chamber, Sofa Kiosk, Mosque, pool, freestanding fountain and general terrace remain native context.
